Event 20 is the corrupted one. It is labelled Team A, but P259 is a Team B Right Wing. That player carried the ball in event 19 for Team B. The pass in event 20 is then received by P247, Team B's goalkeeper, in event 21. So event 20 should belong to Team B, which makes this a wrong_team corruption.
